name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 9, 2008
03:30 A.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Harlan Dunn, President of Kiwanis Club
Recommended Action:
of Sunrise Vista*3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to Vista Fire Chief Gary Fisher declaring September 2008 "National Preparedness Month" in the City of Vista.
P2.
Presentation by Dan McAllister, San Diego County Treasurer-Tax Collector.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC/BSD/CDC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
1.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-25, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Section 17.60.090 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to the Collection of Development Impact Fees."
2.
City Council Ordinance No. 2008-26, entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Title 18 of the Vista Development Code with Respect to Large Family Day Care Homes."
C5.
Application for Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC) License and Cabaret License, Colimas Mexican Restaurant, 1850 Hacienda Drive, Ste. 22 (CC)
C6.
Buena Outfall Force Main Phase III Project (BSD)
C7.
No Parking zone on Crescent Drive (CC)
C8.
2008 Justice Assistance Grant (CC)
C9.
Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Annual Performance & Evaluation Report (CAPER) (CC)
C10.
Brengle Terrace Park Maintenance Facility (CC)
DISCUSSION
D1.
Grapevine Road Phase II Street Improvements Project (CC)
1.
Discuss the approach used to call the Deferred Construction Contracts encumbering private property where the City is prepared to construct the improvements along Grapevine Road, and provide direction to staff;
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the design of the Grapevine Road Phase II Street Improvement Project and authorizing bid advertising; and
3.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , demanding installation or construction of the public improvements on Grapevine Road.
D2.
SANDAG Smart Growth Concept Map (CC)
D3.
Inland Rail Trail Project Design Award (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Vacation of a Portion of Tierra Del Cielo (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , vacating a portion of Tierra Del Cielo;
2.
Authorize the City Engineer to take actions to close the identified portion of Tierra Del Cielo; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to record a copy of the resolution.
PH2.
Sewer Reimbursement Agreement between the City of Vista and Richard P. Koval, Trustee of the Koval Revocable Living Trust (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Sewer Reimbursement Agreement between the City of Vista and Richard P. Koval, Trustee for the Koval Revocable Living Trust, owner's agent for APN 171-172-16 and 171-172-17;
2.
Direct the City Clerk to record the resolution establishing the Reimbursement Agreement; and
3.
Authorize the City Clerk to file the resolution, the agreement, and the Notice of Encumbrance with the County Recorder.
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
